column1: # rosetta-causes.tsv -- THE ROSETTA CAUSE TABLE, and the baseline of `tools/rosetta-corpus run`
# THIS FILE LISTS WHAT IS WRONG, like baselines/everyday-baseline.tsv: one row per Rosetta program
# that does NOT match perl; a program that matches has NO row.  NAMES ONLY: the programs and their
# expected output are GFDL text and never enter this repository (tools/rosetta-corpus rebuilds them
# from the pinned commit; baselines/rosetta-corpus.tsv holds their names and digests).  A note is
# one line written by hand -- never a pasted stderr line: PCL's complaints quote the program.
# COLUMNS (TAB-separated): the runner's baseline format with a CLASS column before the cause.
#   area/name        rosetta/NNNN-task, the name in baselines/rosetta-corpus.tsv
#   verdict          DIFF | RC | TIMEOUT, as tools/everyday-smoke.pl decides it
#   first-diff-line  the first differing STDOUT line; `-` for RC and TIMEOUT
#   class            the FIRST-COMPLAINT class (`tools/rosetta-corpus classify`; docs/rosetta-plan.md
#                    section 3), one of: SILENT LOUD NOT-SUPPORTED DROPPED MODULE-MISSING NOTICE
#                    TIMEOUT EXHAUSTED -- where the narrowing starts, not a cause
#   cause            the board's grammar (docs/failure-cause-classes.md "The grammar"): `#N ...` an
#                    OPEN task, `NS:<id> ...` a docs/not-supported.md id, `UNREDUCED #N ...` not
#                    reduced yet -- task N names the program; #2104 holds every seeded row until a
#                    census agent replaces it.  Pl/t/verdict-register-01.t checks every KEY, the
#                    five fields, the class and the name: a typo fails the gate.
# ROWS CHANGE OR LEAVE BY EDIT, never by a re-bless (there is no --bless-baseline):
#   NEW          a differing program with no row             => the run exits 1 (a regression)
#   FIXED        a row whose program is now `same`           => edit the row OUT, citing the batch
#   MOVED        the verdict or the first-diff line changed  => re-attribute it (re-classify too)
#   UNEXPLAINED  a row with an empty cause                   => the run exits 1
#   STALE        a row naming a program that is not there    => the run exits 1
# SEEDED s543o (2026-11-27) from the run of MAIN-READY-111 0ab08642 (gen v2-16300), confirmed by
# s543o's own run of the same code through `tools/rosetta-corpus run`.  On the 652-program corpus
# of 2026-11-24: 547 identical, 105 differing -- SILENT 43, LOUD 28, NOT-SUPPORTED 12, DROPPED 11,
# MODULE-MISSING 4, NOTICE 3, TIMEOUT 2, EXHAUSTED 2 (the plan's section 3 table, program for
# program, on -110).  TWO OF THE 105 LEFT THE CORPUS with their rows (baselines/rosetta-corpus.tsv's
# header: broken probes, not PCL's): 0359 (nondeterministic; NOT-SUPPORTED, regex code blocks) and
# 1442 (its expectation holds the bless date; SILENT).  So 547 of 650, 103 rows -- SILENT 42,
# LOUD 28, NOT-SUPPORTED 11, DROPPED 11, MODULE-MISSING 4, NOTICE 3, TIMEOUT 2, EXHAUSTED 2.
# 17 are keyed on their not-supported id (10 regex code blocks, 2 given / when, 4
# Unicode::Normalize (XS), 1 bigrat); the other 86 are UNREDUCED #2104 for the census
